messages:
alex_v: Preflight check — can someone confirm the unpin criteria and exact backout runbook we should follow for the api deploy in the 2-4pm change window? Deploybot starts canary in ~10m. Need an explicit owner for unpin and rollback notes.

deploybot: deploybot: canary scheduled by @alex_v for service/api commit abc123. Canary window 10m, id=c-789. Posting metrics every 60s.

lina: Link to runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/deploy-backout — follow steps 1→6. Step 3 has the unpin commands and step 5 covers traffic fallback.

maria: For clarity the thresholds we use: error-rate delta > 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increase >= 50% vs baseline for two consecutive windows. Also treat any synthetic test failures > 0.5% as a hard trigger.

jordan: I can own the unpin and rollback actions. If triggered I'll run: ```rdwctl rollout revert --service api --to-tag v1.42 --reason "canary failure"``` then follow runbook to disable burst and pin fallback. I'll notify #eng-oncall after revert.

alex_v: Good — add to runbook note: after unpin, run the smoke suite (see step 4) and then disable autoscale burst and switch routing to fallback region (runbook step 5).

maria: Confirming post-unpin checklist: 1) smoke suite green, 2) mark release notes as reverted, 3) open rollback incident (sev2) if smoke fails.

deploybot: deploybot: canary started at 1739954380 (id=c-789). Will emit metric pings to this thread every 60s.

lina: :thumbsup: I'll page infra if we need capacity for the fallback rollout.

oncall: oncall: standing by. If unpin happens I will assume incident lead and coordinate comms to #customer-notify.

alex_v: Locking this thread as the single source of truth for unpin criteria. Proceed with canary; ack here when smoke is green or if any threshold trips. Thanks everyone.
